questions.question: The Reubenites and Gadites had large herds and found good grazing land. What did they ask Moses for?

answers.text: Let them have this land and not cross the Jordan
Let them have more of the war spoil
Let them take the best land in Canaan

questions.question: After Israel's fathers discouraged the people from entering the promised land, how long did the LORD make Israel wander in the wilderness?
The Reubenites and Gadites planned to build cities for their little ones and folds for their flocks. What did Moses tell them to do?

answers.text: Pay a tribute to the LORD

questions.question: Moses gave land east of the Jordan to the Gadites, the Reubenites and half of which tribe?
